WITH linked AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(acl_igm) AS overall_mean
    FROM linked
), deviations AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - overall_mean AS deviation
    FROM linked
    CROSS JOIN overall
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation,
       excess AS `excess above sex average`
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
